decision: Close the fixed-c32 cluster handoff and bounded N-tile recomputation families. Retain the corrected materialized exact producer as the only source-complete decomposition. Do not request a GPU for a direct-handoff candidate unless a materially new exact SM90a consumer source first clears the source, resource, and traffic contract below.

consumer_trace.activation: row-major E4M3FN [M,5376] with contiguous FP32 [M,1] scale
consumer_trace.weight: column-major E4M3FN [5376,16384], stride [1,5376], with contiguous FP32 [1,16384] scale
consumer_trace.interface_fact: The pinned CUTLASS mainloop receives global mat_a and mat_b pointers; it has no DSM producer channel.

analytical_falsification.stock_consumer: N=16384 and 64-column tiles produce 256 CTAs, or 1.9394 waves on 132 SMs.
analytical_falsification.single_cluster_handoff: One portable eight-CTA cluster must execute 32 N tiles per CTA to cover 256 tiles, replacing about two stock waves with 32 serial tile slots.
analytical_falsification.bounded_n_tile_recomputation: Sharing one exact producer across 1, 2, 4, or 8 N tiles requires respectively 256, 128, 64, or 32 complete producer copies.
analytical_falsification.concurrency_parity_handoff: Preserving two N-tile slots requires 16 eight-CTA clusters and therefore 16 exact producer copies. At M=32 each CTA performs four serial exact row rounds, the cluster requires at least three producer/publication phases before WGMMA, and each block retains 21,504 FP8 activation bytes through the mainloop.
analytical_falsification.shared_storage_pressure: At M=32 the persistent activation is 87.5% of the 24,576-byte A/B payload of one CUTLASS mainloop stage. It must consume auto-stage residual or remove a stage; DSM-to-local staging remains required.
analytical_falsification.traffic_conservation_m32: The concurrency-parity path adds 10,321,920 bytes of producer global reads versus the one-copy materialized producer while removing only 172,032 activation-store bytes. It leaves all 88,080,384 QKV weight bytes and all WGMMA work intact.
analytical_falsification.loose_whole_request_ceiling: Even making the entire prior rejected-source M=32 producer median free would save only 0.011856960263103247 seconds/request, 1.8966619256726117% of the fixed 0.625149101968745-second denominator. Legal nonmaterialized families do not attain that bound because they duplicate rather than eliminate the producer.

cpu_reference_fragment_oracle.result: For M=1/16/32, all 21 K=256 fragments per row reassemble to the exact materialized E4M3 bytes and scale-owner bytes. Deterministic FP32 fragment references match materialized references bitwise for eight real Q/K/V columns spanning tile and projection boundaries. The stock signed-zero contract also passes.
cpu_reference_fragment_oracle.transfer_limit: This CPU oracle establishes producer bytes, fragment ownership, indexing, and sampled real-weight arithmetic. It does not establish CUTLASS FP8FastAccum accumulation order or complete BF16 output bytes.

exact_consumer_gpu_contract_if_reopened.prerequisite: A source-complete custom SM90a consumer implementing 16 clusters x 8 CTAs, two 64-column N tiles per CTA, and cluster-distributed exact producer bytes.
exact_consumer_gpu_contract_if_reopened.control: Corrected exact-order materialized producer plus the pinned fp8_scaled_mm consumer.
exact_consumer_gpu_contract_if_reopened.candidate: The source-complete 16x8 DSM consumer, without global E4M3 activation materialization.
quality_gate: exact complete E4M3 activation and FP32 scale bytes
exact complete BF16 [32,16384] QKV output bytes
candidate symbol and cluster launch proof
register, shared-memory, spill, and cluster occupancy evidence
exact_consumer_gpu_contract_if_reopened.measurement: On the same H200 session, collect at least three alternating warm medians for control and candidate. Reopen only if the candidate median is strictly lower.

limitations: This is a source-bound analytical negative for the three prescribed fixed-c32 decomposition families, not a universal proof against every future custom GEMM.
Vendor hardware facts are labeled vendor-reported; no target-H200 measurement was made in this project.
The corrected materialized producer's target-H200 result remains owned by its separately funded project and was not replayed here.
next_action: Preserve this terminal. Do not nominate or claim a GPU for these closed handoff families. Track the separately funded corrected materialized-producer result; re-admit this lane only with materially new exact SM90a consumer source that satisfies the reopening contract.
